FlowerPainter.Park.Feature.plaza.Tooltip: A paved square inside the park. Paths lead to its edge; trees keep clear of it.
FlowerPainter.Park.Feature.pond.Tooltip: A pond between the paths. Permanently lowers the terrain: removing the park leaves the basin.
FlowerPainter.Park.plazaAt.Tooltip: Where the plaza sits: in the middle, in a corner, against the longest side, or next to an entrance.
FlowerPainter.Park.plazaSize.Tooltip: Share of the park the plaza covers (12–90 m across). Made smaller when it does not fit.
FlowerPainter.Park.lakeSize.Tooltip: How much of the open space between the paths the pond may take.
FlowerPainter.Park.Issue.PlazaSmaller: The plaza was made smaller to fit the park.
FlowerPainter.Park.Issue.NoRoomForPlaza: There is no room for the plaza in this park.
FlowerPainter.Plaza.Feature.trees.Toolti: Shade trees in a grid, or green islands with trees.
FlowerPainter.Plaza.Feature.fountain.Too: A large fountain with seating takes the centre of the square.
FlowerPainter.Campground.Feature.restroo: Restroom buildings you choose; replaces the automatic facilities.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Feature.edgeZoning.T: Zones the land along the new streets so buildings grow there.
FlowerPainter.Pond.Name: Pond
FlowerPainter.Pond.depth.Tooltip: How far the basin is dug below the water line.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Kiosk.Name: Food stands
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Kiosk.benches.Toolti: Two benches in front of each stand.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.PlazaTrees.Name: Plaza trees
FlowerPainter.AddOn.PlazaTrees.layout.To: A regular grid of trees, or round green islands with a few trees each.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.PlazaTrees.spacing.T: Distance between trees (grid) or between islands.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Restrooms.kiosk.Tool: Puts a kiosk next to each restroom.
FlowerPainter.Place.Issue.InvalidParent: The area is not a valid shape for a place inside it.
FlowerPainter.Place.Issue.NoRoom: The place does not fit inside the area.
